The October Northern Expansion of Imperium Romae Marii:
[img]https://i.ibb.co.com/8n43TNRs/ERENE-political.png/img]
Short description:
Seeing that Sanguivallis and Akhratia expanded, Imperium Romae Marii Expanded North and finally created a colony in Vespuria.
Long description:
In pre-October 2025, the nations of Sanguivallis and Akhratia expanded. Sanguivallis expanded northeast, while Akhratia expanded northwest. Officials of Imperium Romae Marii began to suggest an expansion into the north for minerals and more land for the population, especially since Nederalnd (New Dutch Territories) was already not enough, so an expedition was created to gain more land.

Meanwhile, some officials decided to create a colony in North Vespuria, however, due to the trauma of the Failed invasion of 2009, the idea of a colony was postponed.

then in mid-October, the Romariian Military executed the expedition up north, altough there was not that much Fighting, and if there were, it was mostly tribal groups. The terrain was a challenge, and the expedition killed at least 200.000 romariian soliders, but atleast Imperiu Romae marii managed to gain more land.

in late october, after the succses of the expedition, the idea of a colony in north vespuria was executed, but this time, not as carelessly than in 2009.

an armada of 69 romarian vessels departed from Romarian mainland and went to North Vespuria.

The landing was successful, although fighting between local tribes and people did happen, at least 100,000 Romarian soldiers died. The colony was named "Lunimbia", altough the colony was small, it was a good idea to slowly gain more land instead of immediately trying to absorb more land as possible. To secure the colony, any people from Thrysmora or Camphill will be deported back to their nations.

After the 2 successful expeditions, a party was held, YIPPIE!!! also a small part of the weird chicken head of Imperium Romae Marii was removed and became unowned, and the small mushroom shape unowend hole close to the chicken head has not been absorbed yet.

(please, let this land expansion be finally accepted 😫)[/quote]

[b]----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------[/b]

As many of yall know, Shamat is the combined continents of East, and West Shamat.

Although differences are present, people from Shamat always have had a feeling of a bond with each other, especially compared to their connections with other continents. Neo-Colonialism is still present at all current times, and people usually don't like those nations being present on their continents, some exceptions are very much present, but there will always be a feeling of external influences.

50 years ago, something ignited, something started, in a lot of forms and identities, but it was still unknown, [i]sadly[/i]. Many forms and versions existed, you can call them what you want; left, right, progressive, conservative, extreme, centrist and beyond. Even people from Shamat, who were outside Shamat, felt a connection to this idea, to this concept.

It grew and it grew, at some point every single person in a city would know about it. The Idea of Shamatism and/or Pan-Shamatism. BUT, the problem was, no one was truly expressing it yet, and no one truly saw it as something doable. Until one certain day in the Sikirskian province of Zirsk, to be precise, in the now-very-important city of [b]Kerlgrad:[/b]
